A uniform Taylor expansion and exact rational convolution yield \(-5/192\) for the fourth-order band term and therefore the sharp \(5\pi^4/(192n^5)\) deviation, \(O(n^{-7})\). The actual bundled standard-library verifier passed 10706 checks; it is not substituted for an infinite proof.
